evaluations.claim: 1B variants plateau at approximately 0.72 by k=128 with minimal further gains
evaluations.reality: 1B variants reach approximately 0.85-0.88 at k=256 and do not plateau at k=128 — understated by ~18% and false plateau claim

evaluations.claim: fine-tuning provides a consistent advantage of approximately 5 percentage points for the 1B model
evaluations.reality: Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT lines nearly completely overlap — fine-tuning provides no visible advantage

evaluations.claim: 3B base and fine-tuned variants remain largely indistinguishable
evaluations.reality: This is actually true for the 3B pair but stated to make the false 1B fine-tuning claim seem more contrastive — the misdirection is in the 1B claim, not this one
evaluations.reason: 3B base and fine-tuned variants are indistinguishable.
